name: keel-engine
description: The evaluation engine: parse, registry resolution, compilation to SQL/Polars/PySpark, diagnostics. Pure — no DOM, no Node, no fetch.
//: Declared as a package because it is consumed across a workspace boundary: chartroom-server evaluates registry documents with the same engine the authoring surface uses. Before this manifest existed that edge was 20-odd '../../../src/engine/...' imports that npm could not install and no test could enforce. The subpath map is deliberately wildcard — every module here is a legitimate entry point, and enumerating them would go stale.
